name: Pose
description: A bright, notation-led template for yoga and movement studios — chalk-white canvas, mist-teal panels, deep teal ink and one chartreuse spark, every pose drawn as a numbered pictogram plate, a Sun Salutation that breathes across the page, a week-at-a-glance timetable with levels you can read at a glance, and a try-a-week offer at every turn. Ships two homepage looks.

variants.notation: Type-led hero with every class as a pictogram plate, no photo

default_variant_description: Plain headline beside a wide photo labelled like a pose plate
